headline: Dockworker Union Strikes Paralyze Antwerp Container Terminal Operations
summary: Belgian transport unions initiate an unannounced 72-hour wildcat strike across Port of Antwerp docks, freezing customs release and crane shifts.

headline: Super Typhoon Gaemi Forces Evacuation of Northern Taiwan Industrial Parks
summary: Authorities mandate shutdown of non-essential wafer fabrication support and secondary chemical processing facilities across Hsinchu and Taoyuan.
